content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

How many property sales were recorded in each calendar month of 2024?

content.statement:
SELECT *
FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
    ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID_SEMANTIC
    METRICS sales_count
    DIMENSIONS uk_price_paid.month
    WHERE uk_price_paid.date >= '2024-01-01' AND uk_price_paid.date < '2025-01-01'
)
ORDER BY month DESC NULLS LAST

;
